messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: release cut blocked — preflight-windows failed after artifact restore. Getting 403 on artifact fetch then long-path errors during unpack.
Rafael: paste log?
Ivy: "GET .../release-2025-03.tgz 403" then later "OSError: [WinError 206] filename too long" when unpacking partial tar.
build-bot: CI: job 4721 (preflight-windows) failed: artifact-restore 403.
Rafael: Could be presign expiry or a permissions regression. Any recent changes to publisher or cache-prune?
Ivy: Yes, staging-publisher shortened presign TTL last week. Queue delays can exceed that.
Nora (PM): If we hold, I need a short note for PMs.
Rafael: Fast options: (A) bump presign TTL in publisher (one-line), (B) change runner unpack dir to a short path to avoid long-name crash, (C) revert presign change (bigger blast).
Ivy: I'll apply a manual hold for the cut.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Manual hold applied to release/cut/2025-03-09 by Ivy \u2014 promotion blocked.
Rafael: Opening TTL bump PR now, aim to deploy in ~20m. Also prepping a tiny runner patch as fallback.
build-bot: CI: presign-ttl PR merged to staging.
build-bot: CI: retriggered preflight-windows #4722 queued by Rafael.
build-bot: CI: preflight-windows #4722 SUCCESS.
Ivy: Removing manual hold after green preflight. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Manual hold removed on release/cut/2025-03-09 by Ivy \u2014 promotion allowed.
